snapshot.title: Cusco - Breathable Nail Polish
snapshot.description: This deep mauve pink is inspired by the stunning rainbow mountain of Cusco, Peru. Known as Vinicunca, or the mountain of seven colors, the mountain is considered a holy site in Peru. Cusco is the former capital city of the Incas, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and the oldest continuously inhabited city in the Americas. Cusco is a deep mauve pink cream. Cusco is darker and cooler than Jaipur and less bright compared to Monduli.
snapshot.pdp_how_to_use_raw: For water permeability, apply 1-2 thin coats. To extend polish longevity, prep the nail by shaping and buffing before application. Enhance nail health by finishing with our Almond & Ginseng Cuticle Oil .

pdp_details_sections.body: This deep mauve pink is inspired by the stunning rainbow mountain of Cusco, Peru. Known as Vinicunca, or the mountain of seven colors, the mountain is considered a holy site in Peru. Cusco is the former capital city of the Incas, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and the oldest continuously inhabited city in the Americas. Cusco is a deep mauve pink cream. pdp_details_sections.heading: How to Use
pdp_details_sections.body: For water permeability, apply 1-2 thin coats. To extend polish longevity, prep the nail by shaping and buffing before application. Enhance nail health by finishing with our Almond & Ginseng Cuticle Oil .

pdp_details_sections.heading: Details
pdp_details_sections.body:
Halal certified and wudu-friendly , our innovative formula allows water permeation, providing a solution for those seeking breathable nail products.
Our nail polishes boast a 21-free, non-toxic, plant-based formula, ensuring a safe and eco-friendly beauty experience
Express yourself freely with our nail polish, crafted to be inclusive and welcoming to individuals of all ethical and spiritual backgrounds

pdp_faq_items.question: How long before I get my order?
pdp_faq_items.answer: You can expect to have your package in 4-7 business days once shipped in the United States & Canada.

pdp_faq_items.question: Where are 786 polishes made?
pdp_faq_items.answer: 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are manufactured and produced in the United States.

pdp_faq_items.question: How can I ensure water permeability?
pdp_faq_items.answer: To ensure water permeability, we suggest using no more than two thin coats of 786 Cosmetics nail polish. This can be one coat of color and one coat of a top coat, or two coats of color. We make our halal nail polishes highly pigmented so you won't need to apply more than one coat of nail polish for most of our colors.

pdp_faq_items.question: How are 786 polishes Halal?
pdp_faq_items.answer: 786 Cosmetics has worked with Islamic scholars to understand the requirements for halal nail polish. For more information please visit the How It Works page. There are two qualities that make 786 Cosmetics halal. 786 Cosmetics products contain no animal products or byproducts and no prohibited alcohol. 786 Cosmetics nail polishes are water permeable – this means it can be worn during wudu. When the nails are rubbed, water permeates the nail polish making your wudu valid.
